correctness_review.summary: This PR addresses a bug where deterministic edge sorting in an undirected graph could result in lower-information relations overwriting higher-information ones, leading to the loss of important call edges.

findings.title: Correctness of Relation Priority Handling
findings.detail: The introduction of `_RELATION_PRIORITY` ensures that when two edges with different relations land on the same (src, tgt) pair in an undirected graph, the higher-information relation wins the collapse. This change prevents lower-priority 'references' from overwriting higher-priority 'calls', ensuring that important call edges are preserved.

findings.title: Handling of Edge Cases
findings.detail: The PR includes a test function `test_build_from_json_calls_survives_references_collapse_either_order` to verify the behavior when calls and references are added in both orders. This ensures that edge cases, such as the order of input edges, are correctly handled.

findings.title: Regression Safety
findings.detail: The PR adds a new test function `test_build_from_json_calls_survives_references_collapse_either_order` to ensure that existing behaviors and contracts are not broken.
